why_stop_under_8_GiB: Fill is dimensionally impossible for d < 7. At d=4 the dense Macaulay matrix is already ~5.2 GiB uint8 and cannot fill; incremental echelon toward rank 163185 would exceed 8 GiB if rank is large. At the first possible fill degree d=7 the dense upper bound is astronomical. Launching F4/GB under 8 GiB is not expected to finish with a decisive certificate. Preflight-and-stop is the authorized successful outcome.
